caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair and a separate detailed sketch of a wooden carving above it. The chair features a dark brown wooden frame with an ornate backrest that includes two intersecting X-shaped supports, each joined at the center by a small decorative element. The top of the backrest is curved with a carved floral or ribbon motif. The seat of the chair is upholstered with a fabric that displays a colorful floral pattern, including shades of red, pink, blue, yellow, and green on a light beige or cream background. The chair has four legs: the front two are straight and fluted while the back two are slightly curved. Above the chair, there is a small, rectangular drawing of a wooden panel or carving, outlined in pencil or ink, decorated with a bow at the center and some branches or garland motifs, indicating a possible design for the chair's backrest. The background is a plain, light beige with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Side Chair
